info.name: Search for images by a photographer

params.name: artist_name
params.description: Name of artist for desired images

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma separated list of fields. Allows restricting which fields are returned. If no fields are selected, the summary_set of fields are returned.

params.name: page
params.description: Identifies page to return. Default page is 1.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Specifies page size. Default page_size is 10, maximum page_size is 100.
